notes: Page restructured around the four weekdays: Thursday Collect, Friday Cut, Monday Write, Tuesday Send. Setup is front and centre on first visit and collapses to one line once your city is saved.
New install verification step: ask Claude which newsletter skills it has before Thursday ever arrives.
The browser triage table is gone; cutting happens in the spreadsheet you already have open, with the judgment guidance kept as prose.
The page now stores only your city, week, sources, and log. Writing happens in the assembled document, helped by copy-the-scaffold buttons.
Troubleshooting section for the common failure modes.
Import a backup: the workspace bar can now load a previously exported .json file, restoring sources, sheets, drafts and the issue log. Export finally has its other half.

Site redesign for clarity: workflow diagram showing where Claude works and where you do, weekly rhythm cards (Thursday collect, Friday cut, Monday write, Tuesday send), plainer copy, new visual system.
First release: ctc-source-map, ctc-harvest, ctc-assemble skills, START-HERE guide, city config template.
Companion site: setup guide, source registry, prompt generators, event-sheet triage, writing workspace, sheet checks, send guide, issue log.
